chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Fadhl from Ibn Bukayr from Hamzah ibn Humran who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who made his female slave upon him like the back of her mother (Zihar), so he said: 'He has intercourse with her and there is no obligation upon him.' This is predicated on the condition that he had neglected the conditions of Zihar as we clarified regarding the two witnesses or purity or other than that. As for with the completion of the conditions, then Zihar is effective according to what we presented earlier. Then he mentioned (may Allah have mercy on him) regarding the expiation of the slave when he performs Zihar, it is fasting for one month, unlike other types of expiations, and we have presented that earlier, and what we narrated reinforces it:

key_terms.الظِّهَار: Zihar (a form of divorce where the husband likens his wife's back to his mother's back)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of Zihar for a female slave and what is its expiation?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that the validity of Zihar applied to a female slave depends on the fulfillment of specific conditions, such as witnesses or purity; if these are lacking, the husband may have intercourse without expiation. It further establishes that the prescribed expiation for a slave is fasting for one month, a ruling supported by prior discussions in the text. This highlights the Shia juristic distinction between the status of slaves and free women in marital jurisprudence.
